$comment: Shared per-agent context preload for both harnesses (OpenCode: .opencode/plugins/gim-preload.js every turn; Cursor: .cursor/hooks/gim-preload.ps1 at session start and Task spawn), per docs/adr/agents/0009-AGENTS-context-preload.md. Each agent has two independent sections. 'skills' is a list of skill names, resolved to SKILL.md under the repo-local roots .agents/skills, then .opencode/skills and .claude/skills. 'files' is a list of arbitrary file paths (prefs, checklists, whatever), relative to the project root or absolute. Skills are appended first, then files. The material is attached to the agent's context: every turn in OpenCode, at session start or Task spawn in Cursor. Changes take effect on the next turn; only the .js (OpenCode) needs a restart.
header: Reference material, preloaded. Attached to this agent's context.
